A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 28-page CoP paper, including Appendices A–Q. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support reliable comparison of the text, mathematics, tables, figures, and appendix examples.

before.justification: V2 reports original jailbreak evaluations on HarmBench and JailbreakBench, including attack success rates, query efficiency, component ablations, and qualitative examples.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical evaluations and their results in Section 4 and the appendices.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 and Appendix C retain the same seed generation, seven-principle inventory, principle composition, dual judging, and iterative refinement. No method component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same HarmBench and JailbreakBench coverage and target models, including safety-enhanced systems. Appendix H's JailbreakBench experiment already exists in v2; v3 only supplies its missing citation.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the reported experiments, including X-Teaming in Table 3 and PAIR, TAP, and AutoDAN-Turbo in Table 11. Completing GPTFuzzer's citation in Appendix A does not add an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: Sampling, model configurations, judges, metrics, and attack budgets remain unchanged. This includes Appendix H's 100-query, 20-iteration JailbreakBench evaluation using the HarmBench classifier.

E4.justification: The refusal analysis, judge and threshold studies, component ablations, strategy-frequency analyses, and fluency and qualitative examples are retained without revision, including Appendices B, D–G, I–J, and P–Q.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither the reported point estimates and averages nor the documentation of runs, seeds, uncertainty estimation, or significance testing receives any revision.

E6.justification: Reported numerical and qualitative results match throughout. For example, CoP retains 52.0% ASR on Llama-3-8B-Instruct-RR in Table 2 and 81.0% on JailbreakBench in Table 11. Appendix ablation results and example images also match.

T1.justification: The jailbreak formulation in Appendix C, composition notation, and scoring and threshold conditions are unchanged. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same effectiveness, efficiency, and transparency contributions, including the claimed advantages over baselines of up to 19.0 times in attack success and 17.2 times in query efficiency.

C2.justification: Interpretations of composition, expansion strategies, and judge quality remain unchanged. Appendix K retains the same qualifications concerning principle design, agent refusal, imperfect evaluation, resource requirements, and possible extensions.

D1.justification: Appendix C preserves the same prompt templates, model choices, hyperparameters, and A800 hardware information. The project-page link is unchanged; no implementation or code/data access instructions are added.

R1.justification: V3 adds previously missing bibliography entries for Llama Guard, GPTFuzzer, and JailbreakBench as references 25, 26, and 31. These complete attribution for work already discussed or used in v2; substantive research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Unresolved citation markers are repaired, subsequent references are renumbered, and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. Narrative wording, section order, and appendix organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Three additional bibliography entries extend the reference list on page 12, and citation changes cause small local reflow, including Table 2's caption. The nine figures and fifteen tables retain their graphics/data, structure, and placement.

improvement.justification: V3 fixes unresolved citations associated with Table 2, Appendix A, and Appendix H by supplying the Llama Guard, GPTFuzzer, and JailbreakBench references. This improves attribution and traceability, while the method, empirical evidence, and conclusions remain unchanged.
